summary: Defines the Sieve ihave extension, which lets a script use optional Sieve features while still working when those features are missing. It also defines an error command for reporting when no available combination of extensions meets the script's needs. This is a Proposed Standard.

eli5.summary: A recipe can say, if you have a blender, use it; otherwise do something else. This lets mail rules check which tools are available before using them.

questions: how to write portable sieve scripts
